```{r}
## =========================================================================
## fit_spatial_sir(): full pipeline
##   - builds transmission/recovery datasets from before/after-drug tracks
##   - fits MLE (bbmle::mle2), prints convergence code
##   - fits Bayesian posterior (mcmc::metrop), auto-tuning acceptance rate
##   - returns both sets of estimates
##   - produces 5 plots:
##       1. df_before, simulated (MLE params)     vs observed I(t)
##       2. df_before, simulated (Bayesian params) vs observed I(t)
##       3. df_after,  simulated (MLE params)     vs observed I(t)
##       4. df_after,  simulated (Bayesian params) vs observed I(t)
##       5. parameter estimates: MLE (dark grey) vs Bayesian (dark orange),
##          with a vertical dashed line at 0, one row per parameter
## =========================================================================

library(dplyr)
library(bbmle)
library(mcmc)
library(ggplot2)

fit_spatial_sir_short <- function(df_before, df_after, delta = 1, mult_start = 9,
                             n_mcmc = 5000, n_sims = 30, burn = 1000,
                             tune_target = c(0.2, 0.4), tune_max_iter = 15) {

  ## ---- 0. Combine data ----
  df_before$drug <- 0
  df_after$drug  <- 1
  tracks <- bind_rows(df_before, df_after) %>% arrange(drug, cell, frame)

  ## ---- 1. Build transmission blocks (distance matrices, precomputed once) ----
  build_transmission_blocks <- function(tracks, delta) {
    blocks <- list(); k <- 1
    for (d in unique(tracks$drug)) {
      sub <- tracks %>% filter(drug == d)
      frames <- sort(unique(sub$frame))
      for (t in frames) {
        if (!(t + delta) %in% frames) next
        now <- sub %>% filter(frame == t)
        nxt <- sub %>% filter(frame == t + delta) %>% select(cell, state_next = state)
        susc <- now %>% filter(state == 1) %>% left_join(nxt, by = "cell")
        inf  <- now %>% filter(state == 2)
        if (nrow(susc) == 0 || nrow(inf) == 0) next
        D <- sqrt(outer(susc$x, inf$x, "-")^2 + outer(susc$y, inf$y, "-")^2)
        blocks[[k]] <- list(D = D, became_infected = as.numeric(susc$state_next == 2), drug = d)
        k <- k + 1
      }
    }
    blocks
  }

  build_recovery_data <- function(tracks, delta) {
    out <- list(); k <- 1
    for (d in unique(tracks$drug)) {
      sub <- tracks %>% filter(drug == d)
      frames <- sort(unique(sub$frame))
      for (t in frames) {
        if (!(t + delta) %in% frames) next
        now <- sub %>% filter(frame == t, state == 2)
        nxt <- sub %>% filter(frame == t + delta) %>% select(cell, state_next = state)
        if (nrow(now) == 0) next
        now <- now %>% left_join(nxt, by = "cell")
        out[[k]] <- data.frame(became_removed = as.numeric(now$state_next == 3), drug = d)
        k <- k + 1
      }
    }
    bind_rows(out)
  }

  trans_blocks <- build_transmission_blocks(tracks, delta)
  recov_df     <- build_recovery_data(tracks, delta)

  cat("Number of (frame, condition) transmission blocks:", length(trans_blocks), "\n")
  cat("Number of recovery observations:", nrow(recov_df), "\n")

  ## ---- 2. Negative log-likelihood ----
  nll <- function(log_beta1, log_phi, betaD, log_gamma, gammaD) {
    beta1 <- exp(log_beta1); phi <- exp(log_phi); gamma <- exp(log_gamma)

    ll_trans <- 0
    for (blk in trans_blocks) {
      kappa_sum <- rowSums(exp(-blk$D / phi))
      lambda    <- beta1 * exp(betaD * blk$drug) * kappa_sum
      p_inf     <- 1 - exp(-lambda * delta)
      p_inf     <- pmin(pmax(p_inf, 1e-10), 1 - 1e-10)
      ll_trans  <- ll_trans + sum(dbinom(blk$became_infected, 1, p_inf, log = TRUE))
    }

    p_rec  <- 1 - exp(-gamma * exp(gammaD * recov_df$drug) * delta)
    p_rec  <- pmin(pmax(p_rec, 1e-10), 1 - 1e-10)
    ll_rec <- sum(dbinom(recov_df$became_removed, 1, p_rec, log = TRUE))

    -(ll_trans + ll_rec)
  }

  ## ---- 3. MLE fit ----
  start_vals <- list(log_beta1 = log(0.01), log_phi = log(3), betaD = 0,
                      log_gamma = log(0.02), gammaD = 0)

  fit <- mle2(nll, start = start_vals, method = "BFGS", control = list(maxit = 500))

  cat("\nMLE convergence code (0 = converged):\n")
  print(fit@details$convergence)

  mle_est <- coef(fit)
  mle_se  <- sqrt(diag(vcov(fit)))

  ## ---- 4. Bayesian fit: Metropolis-Hastings via mcmc::metrop ----
  log_posterior <- function(par) {
    log_beta1 <- par[1]; log_phi <- par[2]; betaD <- par[3]
    log_gamma <- par[4]; gammaD <- par[5]

    ll <- -nll(log_beta1, log_phi, betaD, log_gamma, gammaD)

    lp <- dnorm(log_beta1, log(0.01), 3, log = TRUE) +
          dnorm(log_phi,   log(3),    3, log = TRUE) +
          dnorm(betaD,     0,         5, log = TRUE) +
          dnorm(log_gamma, log(0.02), 3, log = TRUE) +
          dnorm(gammaD,    0,         5, log = TRUE)

    ll + lp
  }

  init  <- coef(fit)
  Sigma <- vcov(fit)

  # Tune proposal scale toward target acceptance rate by CONTINUING the
  # chain (not restarting), matching the confirmed-working manual approach.
  mult <- mult_start
  out <- metrop(log_posterior, initial = init, nbatch = 1000, scale = Sigma * mult)
  for (i in 1:tune_max_iter) {
    acc <- out$accept
    if (acc >= tune_target[1] && acc <= tune_target[2]) break
    mult <- mult * ifelse(acc > tune_target[2], 1.5, 0.7)
    out <- metrop(out, scale = Sigma * mult)
  }
  cat("\nTuned MCMC acceptance rate:", round(out$accept, 3),
      "(scale multiplier:", round(mult, 3), ")\n")

  # Production run: continue from the tuned chain (do NOT restart from init;
  # continuing is what's been confirmed to work).
  out_long <- metrop(out, nbatch = n_mcmc, scale = Sigma * mult)
  cat("Final long-run acceptance rate:", round(out_long$accept, 3), "\n")

  post <- as.data.frame(out_long$batch)
  colnames(post) <- names(init)
  post <- post[-(1:min(burn, nrow(post) - 1)), ]

  bayes_mean <- colMeans(post)
  bayes_ci   <- apply(post, 2, quantile, probs = c(0.025, 0.975))

return(t(rbind(bayes_mean, bayes_ci)))
}


```


```{r}
bonus = function(df_before, df_after)
{
  n_spans <- 20
before <- vector("list", n_spans)
after  <- vector("list", n_spans)
fits   <- vector("list", n_spans)
time_span_vec <- numeric(n_spans)

for (k in 1:n_spans) {
  time_span_vec[k] <- k * 0.5   # 0.5, 1.0, 1.5, 2.0, ..., 5.0

  b <- df_before %>% filter((frame - 1) %% k == 0) %>% arrange(cell, t_min)
  a <- df_after  %>% filter((frame - 1) %% k == 0) %>% arrange(cell, t_min)

  # Renumber frame to be contiguous (1, 2, 3, ...) within each condition,
  # so "next frame" (delta = 1) correctly refers to the next RETAINED
  # time point, not the next raw frame index.
  b <- b %>% group_by(cell) %>% mutate(frame = rank(t_min)) %>% ungroup()
  a <- a %>% group_by(cell) %>% mutate(frame = rank(t_min)) %>% ungroup()

  before[[k]] <- b
  after[[k]]  <- a

  fits[[k]] <- fit_spatial_sir_short(
    df_before = before[[k]], df_after = after[[k]], delta = 1,
    mult_start = 9,
    n_mcmc = 10000, n_sims = 50, burn = 2000,
    tune_target = c(0.2, 0.3), tune_max_iter = 15
  )
}
  return(fits)
}


df_before0 <- read.csv("/Applications/mism-hackathon/project/cell-infection/results/trajectory_no_drug_0.csv")
df_after0  <- read.csv("/Applications/mism-hackathon/project/cell-infection/results/trajectory_with_drug_0.csv")
run0 = bonus(df_before0, df_after0)
run0

df_before1 <- read.csv("/Applications/mism-hackathon/project/cell-infection/results/trajectory_no_drug_1.csv")
df_after1  <- read.csv("/Applications/mism-hackathon/project/cell-infection/results/trajectory_with_drug_1.csv")
run1 = bonus(df_before1, df_after1)
run1

df_before2 <- read.csv("/Applications/mism-hackathon/project/cell-infection/results/trajectory_no_drug_0.csv")
df_after2  <- read.csv("/Applications/mism-hackathon/project/cell-infection/results/trajectory_with_drug_0.csv")
run0 = bonus(df_before2, df_after2)
run2
```

```{r}
## =========================================================================
## Plot each of the 5 model parameters (Bayesian mean + 95% CI) across a
## sequence of fits[[i]] run at different effective time spans.
## =========================================================================

library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(ggplot2)

param_names <- c("log_beta1", "log_phi", "betaD", "log_gamma", "gammaD")

## -------------------------------------------------------------------------
## 1. Extract bayes_mean + 95% CI from every fits[[i]] into one long data frame
## -------------------------------------------------------------------------
## time_span_vec: numeric vector, same length as `fits`, giving the actual
## time span (in minutes, or whatever unit is meaningful) for each element.
## e.g. if fits[[i]] corresponds to subsampling every i-th 0.5-min step,
## time_span_vec <- (1:length(fits)) * 0.5

extract_param_summary <- function(fits, time_span_vec,
                                   param_names = c("log_beta1", "log_phi",
                                                    "betaD", "log_gamma", "gammaD")) {
  stopifnot(length(fits) == length(time_span_vec))

  map_dfr(seq_along(fits), function(i) {
    f <- fits[[i]]
    data.frame(
      time_span = time_span_vec[i],
      param     = param_names,
      mean      = unname(f[param_names, "bayes_mean"]),
      lower     = unname(f[param_names, "2.5%"]),
      upper     = unname(f[param_names, "97.5%"])
    )
  })
}

## -------------------------------------------------------------------------
## 2. Build one plot per parameter: x = time_span, y = mean, error bar = 95% CI
## -------------------------------------------------------------------------
make_param_plot <- function(summary_df, param_name, ylab = param_name) {
  df <- summary_df %>% filter(param == param_name)

  ggplot(df, aes(x = time_span, y = mean)) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper), width = 0.15,
                  color = "darkorange", linewidth = 0.8) +
    geom_point(color = "black", size = 2) +
    geom_line(color = "black", alpha = 0.4) +
    labs(x = "Time span (min)", y = ylab,
         title = paste("Bayesian estimate vs. time span:", param_name)) +
    theme_minimal()
}

## -------------------------------------------------------------------------
## 3. Usage
## -------------------------------------------------------------------------
 time_span_vec <- (1:length(fits)) * 0.5   # adjust to match how fits was built

 summary_df <- extract_param_summary(frun0, time_span_vec)

 plots <- setNames(
   lapply(param_names, function(p) make_param_plot(summary_df, p)),
   param_names
 )

plots$log_beta1
plots$log_phi
plots$betaD
plots$log_gamma
plots$gammaD

## -------------------------------------------------------------------------
## Optional: all 5 in one combined figure (requires patchwork)
## -------------------------------------------------------------------------
library(patchwork)
combined <- plots$log_beta1 / plots$log_phi / plots$betaD /
            plots$log_gamma / plots$gammaD
combined
```
